name: GhostInteractiveSurface
description: Themed wrapper around headless GhostInteractiveSurface. Same as/effects props; importing it loads the default stylesheet and scopes recipes to this instance. Spotlight tokens come from defineTheme interactivity. Hand-written because the wrapper is a .ts defineComponent.

props.name: as
props.description: Rendered root element, forwarded to the unstyled GhostInteractiveSurface.

props.name: effects
props.description: Recipes advertised on data-interactive. v1 supports spotlight only.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Surface content. The glow layer is rendered by the unstyled primitive.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: The root element after mount; null before mount and after unmount. Delegates to the unstyled GhostInteractiveSurface.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The element selected by as, inside the display:contents themed scope.

parts.name: glow
parts.description: Decorative spotlight overlay painted from interactive.spotlight tokens.

states.name: off
states.description: Reduced motion, coarse pointer, or empty effects. Glow is not shown.

states.name: idle
states.description: Capable of tracking. Glow opacity is 0.

states.name: tracking
states.description: Pointer is over the host. Glow follows --ghost-pointer-x/y.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-interactive-spotlight-size
cssProperties.description: Glow diameter. Subtle default 10rem; none is 0px; expressive is 20rem.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-interactive-spotlight-color
cssProperties.description: Glow color. Aliases action.primary.bg so mono stays a hairline.

cssProperties.name: --ghost-interactive-leave-spring-duration
cssProperties.description: Leave-settle duration. Instant tracking, spring on leave.
